checks.title: CERT-In directions applicability and entity classification
checks.verify: Determine whether the 28 April 2022 CERT-In Directions apply to the entity and which rule-specific categories are relevant. Do not infer a provider category from a product label alone.

checks.title: ICT system clock synchronisation
runtime_tests: Inspect configured time sources across representative ICT systems and verify clocks are synchronised to NIC/NPL or traceable time sources, or another accurate standard source for multi-geography infrastructure that does not deviate from NIC/NPL.
checks.verify: Review Direction (i). Validate actual time-source configuration and drift rather than relying on architecture documentation only.

checks.title: Reportable cyber-incident workflow within six hours
runtime_tests: Run a tabletop with a synthetic Annexure-I incident; record the time the incident is noticed/brought to notice and verify escalation can produce an initial CERT-In report within six hours using information then available, with follow-up information added later.
checks.verify: Review Direction (ii), Annexure I and current CERT-In FAQ. Confirm the incident category and reporting trigger before concluding that the six-hour requirement applies.

checks.title: CERT-In point of contact and response channel
runtime_tests: Verify the nominated CERT-In point of contact is current, reachable, known to incident responders and can receive/escalate CERT-In communications.
checks.verify: Review Direction (iii) and Annexure II. Keep the point-of-contact information updated with CERT-In.

checks.title: Ability to respond to CERT-In information and assistance directions
runtime_tests: Tabletop a CERT-In request for information or assistance with a specified timeframe; verify ownership, legal escalation, evidence preservation and a path to provide the requested information/action without exposing unrelated data.
checks.verify: Review Direction (iii). This is readiness for responding to a lawful CERT-In direction, not evidence that any particular request currently exists.

checks.title: ICT logging, 180-day retention and India-location requirement
runtime_tests: Inspect representative ICT log sources, retention policies and storage regions; verify logs are enabled, securely retained for a rolling 180 days, maintained within Indian jurisdiction, and can be exported for an incident or CERT-In direction.
checks.verify: Review Direction (iv). Test actual retention and storage location rather than assuming the cloud provider's account region proves compliance.

checks.title: Data centre/VPS/cloud/VPN subscriber records
runtime_tests: Using synthetic customer records, verify capture/validation of the required subscriber fields and five-year post-cancellation/withdrawal retention workflow, subject to current law and the applicable provider category.
checks.verify: Review Direction (v), the FAQ and the 27 June 2022 extension notice. Apply only to the specified provider categories and re-check any current validation/retention guidance.

checks.title: Virtual-asset provider KYC and transaction records
runtime_tests: Using synthetic records, verify required KYC and transaction data can be retained for five years and a transaction can be reconstructed with the relevant identifiers, timestamps/time zones and transaction details.
checks.verify: Review Direction (vi) and current definitions/financial-sector KYC requirements. Apply only to covered virtual asset service providers, exchanges or custodian-wallet providers.

limitations: This pack models the CERT-In 28 April 2022 Directions and related FAQ/extension materials; it is not a complete Indian cyber-security law pack.
Incident-reporting applicability and incident classification are fact-specific. A security alert is not automatically a reportable incident.
Provider-specific subscriber-record duties apply only to the listed provider categories; Beacon does not infer those categories from marketing language.
A PASS reflects supplied evidence for a readiness check, not a legal determination or regulator approval.
